violation_type.title: Medication No Longer Used (26 TAC §744.2659)
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation had two expired medications at the operation for children that the medication was prescribed for.

finding_variants.text: The operation had two expired medications at the operation for children that the medication was prescribed for.
Seven of the children's medications for allergy plans were expired.
The Epi pens for one child's allergy action plan expired in November of 2025.
The operation was unable to locate the medication for two children and the medication could not be returned to the parents.
3 children have present medication that is no longer needed or used. 2 children have been unenrolled and 1 child no longer has an allergy.
